findings_or_gaps: REGRESSION: `happy_plants_grow_with_light_and_nutrients` end-to-end test fails. Plants start at 12.000g (2 guilds × 6g from apply_named_scenario_tuning) and decline to 8.244g after 30 days. Root cause: this test uses StartupLightPreset::Hours10 (10h photoperiod), while the scenario default is now 12h. With the new DIC coupling active, 12g of plant biomass at 10h light on 12.5 mg C/L source water is carbon-limited: the daily DIC credit (0.075 × 12g × 10h = 9.0 mg C) cannot sustain maintenance + growth at that biomass. Either the per-guild tuning (6g) needs to be lower, or the test expectation needs adjustment, or the DIC credit calculation needs to account for the photoperiod mismatch.
